prompts.prompt:
Localize and refine the ATTACHED Ryn annotated UI review board into ENGLISH for English-speaking desktop users. The source is an existing concept, preserve its composition, all functional areas, icon craft, two-theme layout, callout numbers and review legend. User explicitly asks English language, both LIGHT and DARK retained. ALL visible UI text AND OUTSIDE BOARD ANNOTATIONS MUST BE NATURAL ENGLISH, no Chinese characters anywhere. Target same aspect ratio as reference, high resolution, legible typography. Enlarge text containers or shorten wording gracefully, never cram translated text. All text sentence case except proper name Ryn and abbreviations API, GPU. No large redesign. Low-saturation slate blue actions, no oversaturated blue gradients, dark graphite and light porcelain palette. Remove Mac traffic-light decoration from frames. Windows context: search hint Ctrl+K if shown, NOT Cmd+K. Tiny "Concept · Sample data" footer. Never claim the mockup is live or usable.

Shared sidebar vocabulary EXACT: Home, Services, Devices, Tasks; lower group More: Explore, Messages; bottom Settings. Workspace label "Personal". "Nodes" replaced by "Devices" in ordinary navigation; underlying peer network stays. Own vs other devices clearly supported. Computer types: Home PC and Work PC SAME MONITOR-ONLY icon, Laptop uses actual laptop icon; no tower case. All occurrences consistent. AI icon simple lilac sparkle, no metallic pinwheel. Document icon sage sheet. Endpoint source always explicit. Don't expose pricing or credits. Device name examples Home PC, Laptop, Work PC, Alex's PC, Studio PC. Notes are private. Their English "Private note" distinguishes from shared name. Replace "Private AI" service with "AI chat", action "Open chat"; other services "Document converter", "Transcription"; "API access" for external agent/project entry.
Board-specific localization and corrections:
Board title "01 Home / Your devices at a glance". Left Light, right Dark. Sidebar Home selected. Title "Home", helper "Use your devices. Share what they can do." Button "Add device". Section "My devices". Home PC / Online / RTX 5090 · 2 services / "Study PC, available in the evening"; Laptop / This device / "For travel"; Work PC / Offline / "For work". Home PC selected; pencil edit button near name.
Section "Services on Home PC". AI chat / "Home PC · Only my devices" / "Open chat"; Document converter / "Home PC · Only my devices" / "Open". Supporting row "From other devices" / "Browse services".
Right selected Home PC detail: LEFT endpoint Laptop with laptop icon label "This device"; RIGHT monitor icon "Home PC"; "Connection: Connected"; "Access: Only my devices"; "Share service" button.
Legends "1 Add device: Pair another computer", "2 Edit details: Device name and private note", "3 Open a service: Chat or use a tool", "4 Share service: Choose devices with access". All in English, precise counts.
